CustomField.description: Id-based lookup to the Campaign Group dictionary entry for this campaign. Replaces the former Grouping-campaign hierarchy (Type = 'Grouping' parent records linked via ParentId). Only required when the campaign's Activation_Type__c corresponds to a Campaign Type that defines campaign groups.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the Campaign Group this campaign belongs to. Only Campaign Group dictionary entries are selectable.
CustomField.label: Campaign Group (Dictionary)

lookupFilter.errorMessage: Only Campaign Group dictionary entries are allowed.
